title: Companion worker input and retained task history
description: Run native-worker-proof.mjs setup using the private gateway and native-worker-proof fixture before execution. NATIVE_COMPANION_WORKER_STATE and NATIVE_COMPANION_TOKEN_FILE name private paths.

open-run.intent: Open the real native worker run timeline.

wait-link.intent: The run overview names its native conversation action.

open-conversation.intent: Open the session using the run link, preserving its task and input lease.

wait-native.intent: The conversation composer is available for the selected run.

type.value: Recall the exact value you wrote in mobile-worker.txt from this conversation. Reply with that value only. Do not use tools or write signals.
type.intent: Continue the selected worker from the mobile composer.

send.intent: Send the pinned instruction through the shared API.

verify-input.intent: Verify native task identity, remembered value and exactly one delivered command.

handoff.intent: Dispatch the successor task using real retained-session handoff.

read-only.intent: The open previous task view loses write access after transfer.

task-history.intent: The previous task is visibly identified as frozen history.

verify-history.intent: Prove the prior lease has frozen history and no successor events or mobile writes.

capture-history.intent: Record the frozen prior task and disabled composer after transfer.

cleanup.intent: Cancel only the private successor and verify process cleanup plus slot release.
